topic: Calling the Office about a Sick Kid

script.title: A SICK-DAY PHONE CALL
script.scene_zh: 自家廚房 · 請假電話
script.story_hook: A father calls his boss about his sick child.
script.intro_zh: 父親為了生病的孩子打電話給老闆。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, dear friends! Today a parent calls the office in a pinch.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，親愛的朋友們！今天要聽一個緊急請假的電話。
script.outro: That's today's call! Take care of your people.
script.outro_zh: 今天的電話就到這裡！好好照顧你的家人。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat each line like a real call.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們像講電話一樣，一句一句跟讀。

script.char_b_description: a poised woman in her late fifties with chin-length silver hair swept behind one ear, wearing a charcoal blazer over a cream silk blouse, marking her calendar while she listens
script.youtube_title: 【🤒孩子生病怎麼跟老闆說】「在家工作」怎麼開口？📞請假・託事・道謝句型一次聽夠✨｜Sick Day English
script.youtube_title_en: "Could I Work From Home Today?" — Calling the Office About a Sick Kid
script.youtube_description:
孩子突然發燒，公司還有一場十點的會議——這通請假電話用英文怎麼打？這集跟著爸爸 Kevin 練習：說明孩子狀況、開口請求在家工作、請同事代開會議、承諾隨時上線，也聽聽老闆暖心回應。整段 18 句自然美式口語，附繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完急假的電話不再手抖！
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英文變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Your little one wakes up with a fever — and there's a ten o'clock meeting you can't miss. How do you make that call to your boss in English? Follow Kevin as he explains the situation, asks to work from home, arranges for a coworker to cover the meeting, and promises to stay reachable. A warm, realistic office phone call in 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA and a repeat-after-me section.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🤒請假電話英文｜說明病情・請求遠端・託人代會｜聽完就會開口請假｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
小孩半夜發燒，上午卻還有重要會議，怎麼辦？
用英文跟老闆請假，怎麼說才得體又清楚？

這一集帶大家走進週二早晨的自家廚房，跟著抱著手機的爸爸 Kevin，從致歉開場，說明孩子狀況、請求在家工作、請同事代開會議，最後在老闆的一句「家人第一」中安心掛斷。

你會聽到：
📞 開場與說明：例如「Sorry to call so early.」、「My little one has a fever.」。
🏠 請求與安排：例如「Could I work from home today, if that's fine?」、「Could Dana cover it? I'll send her my notes.」。
💛 體諒與回應：例如「Family comes first, honestly.」、「Take care of the little guy.」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先完整聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把急假的電話打得穩定又禮貌。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

願你每次請假的電話，都能遇到一句「沒問題，先照顧家人」。
script.scene: home kitchen during a phone call
script.thumbnail_action: holding a phone to his ear with a tissue in hand

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, Ms. Lee, sorry to call so early.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔrnɪŋ mɪz li ˈsɑri tə kɔl soʊ ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 早安，李主管，很抱歉這麼早打電話給您。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hello, Kevin. Is everything all right?
dialogue.zh: 你好，凱文。一切都還好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not quite, my little one has a fever, um.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt kwaɪt maɪ ˈlɪtəl wʌn hæz ə ˈfivər əm/
dialogue.zh: 不太好，我家小孩在發燒，呃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh dear, that's never fun. How high?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ dɪr ðæts ˈnɛvər fʌn haʊ haɪ/
dialogue.zh: 噢天哪，那可不好受。燒到幾度？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A hundred and two, so school sent him home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈhʌndrəd ənd tu soʊ skul sɛnt hɪm hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 一百零二度，所以學校讓他回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay. What do you need from our side?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊkeɪ wʌt du ju nid frʌm aʊr saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 這樣啊。你需要我們這邊怎麼配合？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I work from home today, if that's fine?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd aɪ wɜrk frʌm hoʊm təˈdeɪ ɪf ðæts faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 今天我可以在家工作嗎？如果不為難的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, family comes first, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，說真的，家人永遠排第一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you. And about the ten o'clock meeting…
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ænd əˈbaʊt ðə tɛn əˈklɑk ˈmitɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。還有十點的那場會議……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, that's the one I'd worry about.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðæts ði wʌn aɪd ˈwɜri əˈbaʊt/
dialogue.zh: 對，我正想提的就是那一場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could Dana cover it? I'll send her my notes.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ˈdeɪnə ˈkʌvər ɪt aɪl sɛnd hɜr maɪ noʊts/
dialogue.zh: 可以請丹娜代開嗎？我會把筆記都傳給她。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll ask her, no promises, but likely.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl æsk hɜr noʊ ˈprɑməsəz bət ˈlaɪkli/
dialogue.zh: 我來問她，不保證，但機率很大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's plenty. I'll be on email all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈplɛnti aɪl bi ɑn ˈimel ɔl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那就太好了。我今天會全程盯著郵件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Are you able to join the review call?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ɑr ju ˈeɪbə tə dʒɔɪn ðə rɪˈvju kɔl/
dialogue.zh: 好。那場評審電話你還能線上參加嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, after I get him to the clinic, sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈæftər aɪ ɡɛt hɪm tə ðə ˈklɪnɪk ʃʊr/
dialogue.zh: 可以，帶他去診所之後我就上線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. And Kevin, take care of the little guy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ænd ˈkɛvɪn teɪk kɛr əv ðə ˈlɪtəl ɡaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 很好。還有，凱文，專心照顧小鬼頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. Thank you so much for understanding.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl θæŋk ju soʊ mʌʧ fər ˌʌndərˈstændɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我會的。真的非常謝謝你的體諒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime. Text me if anything else comes up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm tɛkst mi ɪf ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls kʌmz ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 別客氣。有任何狀況隨時傳訊息給我。
